name: Wild for Taranaki Community Fund
summary: Annual community fund for biodiversity restoration, trapping and monitoring projects in Taranaki, New Zealand, open to members and non-members, with up to NZD 10,000 a project.
reporting: Funds must be used within 12 months, and recipients give a brief report on outcomes with photos.

geography.quote: The Community Fund is intended to support biodiversity restoration and conservation projects across Taranaki.

amount.quote: A maximum of $10,000 (GST exc) can be applied for.
